AlpaCat is not patient. Can't wait for alpha owner to get home

The cat jumped right up into his arms.

It's like alpha cat could hear him coming from far away.

I'm guessing he saw him through a window. He knew the guy was coming before the door opened.

My cats are always waiting at the door for me when I get home, but they've never been that excited or jumped into my arms.

When I lived at home, my mom told me that my cat would stop whatever he was doing and go run to the windowsill around a minute before I got home. It was like he could hear my car coming and he knew it was my car out of all the other vehicles driving around the neighborhood.

They know what time to expect us, and what sounds we make.

Hobbs used to squawk at me through the door when I got home and was getting my keys out. I asked my neighbour, who's door is right beside mine, if he found it annoying. But he didn't know what I meant since the cat never made noise for him.
I tested it by sending a friend into my place and Hobbs didn't make a sound as she opened my door. When I came around the hallway corner, the squawking started before he could see me.

I think he must have known what my footsteps sounded like. It's the only explanation I can think of.
